evidence: Bean and LP token amounts are far below 2^128 in any realistic supply; the uint128 struct fields cannot overflow with real values. No reachable violation. Reason: value domain is bounded well under the type max.

entry_conditions: Attacker spoofs the cross-domain messenger to mint L2 Beans.
evidence: recieveL1Beans checks msg.sender==BRIDGE && xDomainMessageSender==L1BEANSTALK. The standard OP-stack messenger pattern is correctly applied for auth; spoofing requires breaking the canonical messenger. The real bug here is the EXTERNAL_L1_BEANS==0 cap (tracked as T-005), not the auth check. Reason: auth gate is correct; only the cap is broken.

entry_conditions: Exploit the wrong domain-separator typehash in LibTractor to forge/confuse signatures.
evidence: LibTractor._domainSeparatorV4 uses BLUEPRINT_TYPE_HASH instead of EIP712_TYPE_HASH (a real defect), but the same wrong domain is used for both signing and verification within the contract, so signatures remain self-consistent. No cross-domain replay into a standard EIP-712 domain is enabled because the malformed domain does not collide with a real one. Reason: defect is non-standard but self-consistent; impact is Info/Low (tooling), not a security violation. Logged as invariant CC-002 score 2.
